notes: Dracomicin A - a very large glycopeptide antibiotic (C84, ~7 aminodeoxy-sugars + a chlorinated Trp/dehydro aglycone) in C5D5N. This is a POOR calibration target: the sugar (60-105 ppm / 3-5.7 ppm) and aliphatic regions are a dense overlapped smear of dozens of near-degenerate signals; individual cross-peaks cannot be assigned to specific atoms in a molecule this size within budget. Only a handful of cleanly-resolved diagnostic contours are recorded (3 anomerics, 3 aromatic aglycone CH), positions only, no atom assignment. HSQC/HMBC/COSY otherwise not curated. Recorded minimally and honestly; recommend excluding from per-pair calibration statistics.
